definitions.explanation: The percentage of a country's or region's consumption of a particular resource that is produced domestically. Most commonly discussed in relation to food supply in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧{自給率|じきゅうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: Japan's food self-sufficiency rate is low.

examples.japanese: ⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧{自給率|じきゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Raising the energy self-sufficiency rate is a challenge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧{自給率|じきゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧40⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}っている→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{食|しょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: The fact that the food self-sufficiency rate is below 40 percent is a major issue in terms of food security.

notes:
USAGE:
A frequently discussed topic in Japanese politics and media. Japan's calorie-based food self-sufficiency rate has hovered around 38% in recent years, one of the lowest among developed nations. The government has set targets to increase it. Also discussed in the context of energy policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧{自給率|じきゅうりつ} (food self-sufficiency rate)
- ⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧{自給率|じきゅうりつ} (energy self-sufficiency rate)
- {自給率|じきゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise the self-sufficiency rate)
- {自給率|じきゅうりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ (improvement of the self-sufficiency rate)
